就是真理的聖靈，乃世人不能接受的；因為不見他，也不認識他。你們卻認識他，因他常與你們同在，也要在你們裏面。

fields.text: Assi-kamou ni-peri jau-an, ra ti jau ta ni-peri ymoumi-æn, ka ni-si-kidi-en-nau-kamou ka-'ou-koua-ei-moumi makka-voua, ka maylli-âl-appa ta voua-oumi: alei ka rou ka mamang ka t'oumi-mia-ei-moumi ti Rama-an tou Nanang-au, ka pi'æ-ah [ki anna] ymoumi-æn.

Ye have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and ordained you, that ye should go and bring forth fruit, and that your fruit should remain: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.
不是你們揀選了我，是我揀選了你們，並且分派你們去結果子，叫你們的果子常存，使你們奉我的名，無論向父求甚麼，他就賜給你們。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Atta ta pahkou-sou-en-nau-kamou, alei ka makka-nana-do-ah-kamou makka-vavæ'ango.
These things I command you, that ye love one another.
我這樣吩咐你們，是要叫你們彼此相愛。」

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Heirou mavahier ymou-mi-æn ta næi, mou-mhga-â ka ni-mavahier-ato jau-an si-ouro y-moumi-æn.
If the world hate you, ye know that it hated me before it hated you.
「世人若恨你們，你們知道，恨你們以先已經恨我了。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Heirou makka næi-ka-mou-lava, ynna kavæ'angö-eih ki næi ta â teni: Râ alei ka assi-ka-mou makka næi-ato, ni-peri-ap-pa-mau-kamou tou næi, alei ki anna mavahier ta næi ymoumi-æn.
If ye were of the world, the world would love his own: but because ye are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.
你們若屬世界，世界必愛屬自己的；只因你們不屬世界，乃是我從世界中揀選了你們，所以世界就恨你們。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Mi-balei-a ki na sou-au ymoumi-æn, Assi masaoun tou vavau ki kidi ta koungcia ki Mei-rang tyn. Hei-rou ni-kmou-d'yl-lough ta neni jau-an, kmou-dyl-lough-âl-appa ymoumi-æn: hei-rou nihmaä ta neni ki sou-au, hmaä-âl-appa [ki sou] 'oumi.
Remember the word that I said unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord. If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they have kept my saying, they will keep yours also.
你們要記念我從前對你們所說的話：『僕人不能大於主人。』他們若逼迫了我，也要逼迫你們；若遵守了我的話，也要遵守你們的話。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Ra pam't-auh nein ym-mud ki mamang katta ymoumi-æn alei ki Nanang-au, alei ka assi nein k'alang-in ta teni ka ni-ma-dingi jau-an.
But all these things will they do unto you for my name's sake, because they know not him that sent me.
但他們因我的名要向你們行這一切的事，因為他們不認識那差我來的。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Hei-rou ni-ynna-koh ier-roua masousou neini-æn, ynna a'ou-si ki varau ta neni: râ hnin äoulough ta neni ki tagpag-eih ta varau nein.
If I had not come and spoken unto them, they had not had sin: but now they have no cloak for their sin.
我若沒有來教訓他們，他們就沒有罪；但如今他們的罪無可推諉了。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Ti-mamang ta mavahier jau-an, mavahier-appa ki Rara-man-au.
He that hateth me hateth my Father also.
恨我的，也恨我的父。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Heirou ni-ynna-koh pa-mut ki na ryngei neini-an, ka assi ni-pam't-tin timamang ka pani, ynna ka ä'ou-si ta varau neini-æn: râ hnyn ni-k'ytt-'an nein [ta anna], ka ni-mavahier jau-an ti Ra-raman-appa-mau-ra.
If I had not done among them the works which none other man did, they had not had sin: but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father.
我若沒有在他們中間行過別人未曾行的事，他們就沒有罪；但如今連我與我的父，他們也看見也恨惡了。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Alei ka pavæut-auh ta sou ka na sas'oulat tou Tatouhko nein, Ni-mavahier ta neni jau-an tou ä'ou-si ki alei.
But this cometh to pass, that the word might be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.
這要應驗他們律法上所寫的話，說：『他們無故地恨我。』

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Irou-ra ierrou-âl-ato ta Tama-Paka-haniap, ka padingi-ei-mau-kamou ti Rama-an, ta Joep-pan ki katiktik-an ki sou, ka pa-'ou-kou'-a-n ki Rama, teni ta gmail-ah jau-an.
But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send unto you from the Father, even the Spirit of truth, which proceedeth from the Father, he shall testify of me:
但我要從父那裏差保惠師來，就是從父出來真理的聖靈；他來了，就要為我作見證。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Ka gmail-al-appa-kamou ta ymoumi, alei ka ni-toulam-ka-mou jau-an tou naunamou.
And ye also shall bear witness, because ye have been with me from the beginning.
你們也要作見證，因為你們從起頭就與我同在。」

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. fields.text: Kamamang katta ni-pa-sousou-en-nau ymoumi-æn, alei ka assi-ah-kamou pa-saisaäla kouap-pin.
These things have I spoken unto you, that ye should not be offended.
「我已將這些事告訴你們，使你們不至於跌倒。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Pou-tauwag-ah ra neni ymoumi-æn ki Pæu'i-sasaal-lan: ra ierroua ta kidi ki tæ'lei, ka veiagh ka pakapatei-ah ymou-mi-æn, pæh-dimdim-eih tyn ka 'illig-auh [ki anna] tmamud ki Alid.
They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the time cometh, that whosoever killeth you will think that he doeth God service.
人要把你們趕出會堂，並且時候將到，凡殺你們的就以為是事奉上帝。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Ka pa-am't-eih nein ta ka-mamang katta ymoumi-æn, alei ka assi-nein ni-k'alang-un ta Ra-ma ti jau-appa ki rouma.
And these things will they do unto you, because they have not known the Father, nor me.
他們這樣行，是因未曾認識父，也未曾認識我。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Râ ni-pa-sousou-en-nau-kamou ki mamang katta, alei ka rou ierrou'-âl-ato ta kidi ki tæ'- lei, ka mi-balei-ah-kamou ki ni-vannavanna-en-nau ymoumi-æn: râ assi-mau ni-pa-sousou-en ymoumi-æn ta mamang k'atta tou naunamou kalahei, alei ka i-tou-lam-app'-oh ymoumi-æn.
But these things have I told you, that when the time shall come, ye may remember that I told you of them. And these things I said not unto you at the beginning, because I was with you.
我將這事告訴你們，是叫你們到了時候可以想起我對你們說過了。」

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Ka hnyn d'marang-koh mou-koua tyni-æn ka ni-madin-gi-jau-an, ka assi tmaligh jau-an ta ti mamang ymoumi-æn, Dmarang kow mou-koua tou mang?
But now I go my way to him that sent me; and none of you asketh me, Whither goest thou?
現今我往差我來的父那裏去，你們中間並沒有人問我：『你往哪裏去？』

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Râ alei ka ni-pasousou-en-nau ta mamang katta ymou-mi-æn, patta-haboun-nen-ato ki voulas ta tintin-oumi.
But because I have said these things unto you, sorrow hath filled your heart.
只因我將這事告訴你們，你們就滿心憂愁。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Ra mattæ'i-tiktik-koh ymou-mi-æn, mariang ymoumi-æn ka d'marang-koh: nda rou assi-koh d'marang, assi ierrou'-ah ymoumi-æn ta Tama-Paka-haniap: heirou-ra d'marang-koh, padingi-ei-mau ta teni pa-'oukoua ymoumi-æn.
Nevertheless I tell you the truth; It is expedient for you that I go away: for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but if I depart, I will send him unto you.
然而，我將真情告訴你們，我去是與你們有益的；我若不去，保惠師就不到你們這裏來；我若去，就差他來。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Irou ka ierrou'-âto ta te-ni, pak'is-auh tyn ta næi ki varau, ki katiktik-kan, ki dungdung-en.
And when he is come, he will reprove the world of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:
他既來了，就要叫世人為罪、為義、為審判，自己責備自己。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Ki varau, alei ka assi nein tna-msing-en jau-an:
Of sin, because they believe not on me;
為罪，是因他們不信我；

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Ki katiktik-kan, alei ka d'marang-koh mou-koua ti Ra-ma-an, ka assi-kamou kmytta-âl-ato jau-an:
Of righteousness, because I go to my Father, and ye see me no more;
為義，是因我往父那裏去，你們就不再見我；

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Ki dungdung-en, alei ka kaha'-n-nato dmundung ta Mei-sasou ki næi katta.
Of judgment, because the prince of this world is judged.
為審判，是因這世界的王受了審判。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Madag'-app'-oh ki ynna-mau ka sou ymoumi-æn, râ assi-kamou i-lpough tubbugh hnyn.
I have yet many things to say unto you, but ye cannot bear them now.
「我還有好些事要告訴你們，但你們現在擔當不了。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Irou, ka ierrou'-âl-ato ta teni ka Joep-pan ki katiktik-kan ki sou, teni ta dmylloug-ah ymoumi-æn tou ymmid ki katik-tik-kan ki sou. Ka assi sykkoun-noung-ah masousou, râ kama-mang ka ni-'illing-hen tyn, pa-sousou-eih tyn, kamamang-ap-pa ka ierrou-ah dou roumang pa-'ou-mhg-eih tyn ymoumi-æn.

Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak: and he will shew you things to come.
只等真理的聖靈來了，他要引導你們明白一切的真理；因為他不是憑自己說的，乃是把他所聽見的都說出來，並要把將來的事告訴你們。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Teni ta pou-vavau-ah ki kidi jau-an: ka ar-'auh tyn ki na â-jau, pa-'ou-mhga [ki atta] ymou-mi-æn.
He shall glorify me: for he shall receive of mine, and shall shew it unto you.
他要榮耀我，因為他要將受於我的告訴你們。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Ka mamang ka â-tou Ra-ma, â-jau ta anna: alei ki atta ni-pa-sousou-en-nau, ka ar'-auh tyn ki na â-jau, pa-'ou-mhga ymou-mi-æn.
All things that the Father hath are mine: therefore said I, that he shall take of mine, and shall shew it unto you.
凡父所有的，都是我的；所以我說，他要將受於我的告訴你們。」

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Assi-madallia, ka assi-âl-lato-kamou kmytta jau-an: ka mi-la, assi madallia, ka kmytt-'âl-ato-kamou jau-an, alei ka sah-kakouah-koh mou-koua ti Rama-an.
A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me, because I go to the Father.
「等不多時，你們就不得見我；再等不多時，你們還要見我。」

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Annata ni-mæh-tavætavæhta [rarouma ki] Pahtatæutæu-han tyn, Mang ta pa-sousou-en tyn kanna ymit-æn, Assi madallia, ka assi âl-ato-kamou kmytta jau-an: ka mi-la, assi madallia, ka kmytt'-âl-ato-kamou jau-an: ka, Alei ka sah-kakoua-ah-koh mou-koua ti Rama-an?

Then said some of his disciples among themselves, What is this that he saith unto us, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me: and, Because I go to the Father?
有幾個門徒就彼此說：「他對我們說：『等不多時，你們就不得見我；再等不多時，你們還要見我』；又說：『因我往父那裏去。』這是甚麼意思呢？」

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Ka ni-k'ma ta neni; Mang ta pa-sousou-en tyn kanna; Assi madallia? Assi-kytta mou-mhga mang ta sou tyn.
They said therefore, What is this that he saith, A little while? we cannot tell what he saith.
門徒彼此說：「他說『等不多時』到底是甚麼意思呢？我們不明白他所說的話。」

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Ra ti Jesus ka kmalang ki kamoei-in nein tmaligh tyni-æn, ni-k'ma neini-æn, Mahtavæta-væh-kamou ki atta matetaligh, ka ni-pa-sousou-en-nau, Assi madallia, ka assi-âl-ato-kamou kmyt-ta jau-an: ka mila, Assi madallia, ka kmytt'âl-ato-kamou jau-an?

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Assi makka næi ta neni mama jau-an ka assi-koh makka næi.
They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
他們不屬世界，正如我不屬世界一樣。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Paka-d'lligh-au paka-tiktik ta neni tou katiktik-kan ki sou-oho: nda sou-oho ta katik-tik-kan ki sou.
Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.
求你用真理使他們成聖；你的道就是真理。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Mama ki ni-padadingi-en-hou jau-an pa-'ou-koua tou næi, ni-padingi-au komma-hyn-na pa-'ou-koua ta neni tou næi.
As thou hast sent me into the world, even so have I also sent them into the world.
你怎樣差我到世上，我也照樣差他們到世上。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Ka paka-mado-en-nau paka-d'lligh paka-tiktik jau-an alei neini-æn, ki paka-d'lligh-eil-appa ta neni pakatiktik tou ka-tiktik-kan ki sou.
And for their sakes I sanctify myself, that they also might be sanctified through the truth.
我為他們的緣故，自己分別為聖，叫他們也因真理成聖。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Assi-koh tmou-dyk tmou-mymmia alei neini-æn k'atta, ra alei appa neini-æn ka tna-'msing-ah jau-an ki na sou nein.
Neither pray I for these alone, but for them also which shall believe on me through their word;
「我不但為這些人祈求，也為那些因他們的話信我的人祈求，

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Alei ka mako-i-ä ym'd-dâh mako'i sat ta neni, mama ymhou Rama jau-an, ti jau-appa ymhou-an, ka mako-i-saat-al-ap-pa ta neni ymytt'-æn: alei ka tna-'msing ah ta næi ki ni-padingi-en-hou jau-an.
That they all may be one; as thou, Father, art in me, and I in thee, that they also may be one in us: that the world may believe that thou hast sent me.
使他們都合而為一。正如你父在我裏面，我在你裏面，使他們也在我們裏面，叫世人可以信你差了我來。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Ka ni-phæ-en-nau neini-æn ta keirang-an ki kidi ka na pæp'æ-oho jau-an: alei ka saäsat-ah ta neni mama ka saäsat-kytta ta ymyt-ta.
And the glory which thou gavest me I have given them; that they may be one, even as we are one:
你所賜給我的榮耀，我已賜給他們，使他們合而為一，像我們合而為一。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Ti jau neini-æn, imhou-appa jau-an: alei ka makoi ta-raæug-â 'ta neni makoi-sat, ka kmalang-al-appa ta næi, ki ni-pa-dingi-en hou jau-an, ka ni-kavæ-'angö-en appa'-'mhou neini-æn: mama ki ni-kavæ'angö-en-hou jau-an.
I in them, and thou in me, that they may be made perfect in one; and that the world may know that thou hast sent me, and hast loved them, as thou hast loved me.
我在他們裏面，你在我裏面，使他們完完全全地合而為一，叫世人知道你差了我來，也知道你愛他們如同愛我一樣。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Rama, mamoei-koh tou æ-i-a-koua ei-mau, i-tou-lam-ap-pa jau-an ka ni-phæ-en-hou jau-an: alei ka mararau-ah ta neni ki keirang-en ki kidi-au, ka ni-phæ-en hou jau-an, nda ni-mavæ'angö kow jau-an, rou assi-appa ni-pa-i-tou samding-in ta raroun ki næi.
Father, I will that they also, whom thou hast given me, be with me where I am; that they may behold my glory, which thou hast given me: for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world.
父啊，我在哪裏，願你所賜給我的人也同我在那裏，叫他們看見你所賜給我的榮耀；因為創立世界以前，你已經愛我了。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Rama ka matiktik, assi ni-kmalang ymhou-an ta næi: râ ti jau ta ni-kmalang ymhou-an, ka ni-kmalang-appa ta neni k'atta ki ni-padingi-en hou jau-an.
O righteous Father, the world hath not known thee: but I have known thee, and these have known that thou hast sent me.
公義的父啊，世人未曾認識你，我卻認識你；這些人也知道你差了我來。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Ka ni-pak'alang-en-nau neini-æn ta Nanang oho, ka pa-kalang-eil-appa-mau: alei ka ka-væ'angö-en k'anna ki ni-kavæ-'angö-en-hou jau-an i-tou-koua-âl-ato neini-æn, ti jau-appa nei-ni-æn.
And I have declared unto them thy name, and will declare it: that the love wherewith thou hast loved me may be in them, and I in them.
我已將你的名指示他們，還要指示他們，使你所愛我的愛在他們裏面，我也在他們裏面。」

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. fields.text: Irou mattæ'i-kaha ta ti Je-sus ki mamang k'atta, ni-tpæpænæh lam ki Pahtatæutæu-han tyn mou-arugh ki karout-kout ki Cedron, ka akou raoul hynna, ki ni-sa-rarbou-en tyn ki Pahtatæutæu-han-appa tyn.
When Jesus had spoken these words, he went forth with his disciples over the brook Cedron, where was a garden, into the which he entered, and his disciples.
耶穌說了這話，就同門徒出去，過了汲淪溪。在那裏有一個園子，他和門徒進去了。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Ka ti Judas ka ni-si-vannavanna tyni-æn, ta mou-mhga-appa ki i-tou-kou-'an k'anna, alei ka vounnavounnei ni-mæui-sal-ato hynna ta ti Jesus lam ki Pahta-tæutæu-han tyn.
And Judas also, which betrayed him, knew the place: for Jesus ofttimes resorted thither with his disciples.
賣耶穌的猶大也知道那地方，因為耶穌和門徒屢次上那裏去聚集。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Irou ka ni-patou-lam ta ti Judas tyni-æn [ki tama-macyt] ki [raroum'-appa] ka koungcia ki Tama-p'hik ka si-bavau, ki Fari-seen-appa, ni-ierroua hynna mei-koua ki patta-'æ-uyng an, ki eu-nam ka ta-æuyng-an, ki peika-kou-an-appa macyt.
Judas then, having received a band of men and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, cometh thither with lanterns and torches and weapons.
猶大領了一隊兵，和祭司長並法利賽人的差役，拿着燈籠、火把、兵器，就來到園裏。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Ka dou kavan-'an ti Jesus ta mamang ka pa-ierroua-eih tyni-æn, ni tpæpænæh ta teni k'ma neini-æn, Timang ta ki'ym-noumi?
Jesus therefore, knowing all things that should come upon him, went forth, and said unto them, Whom seek ye?
耶穌知道將要臨到自己的一切事，就出來對他們說：「你們找誰？」

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. fields.text: Ni-mattæ'i v'lli ta neni tyni-æn, Ti Jesus-an ka makka Nazareth. Ni-k'ma ta ti Jesus neini-æn, Ti jau k'atta. Ka ti Judas ka si-vannavanna tyni-æn, ta i-tou-lam-appa neini-æn mi-toukko.
They answered him, Jesus of Nazareth. Jesus saith unto them, I am he. And Judas also, which betrayed him, stood with them.
他們回答說：「找拿撒勒人耶穌。」耶穌說：「我就是！」賣他的猶大也同他們站在那裏。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. As soon then as he had said unto them, I am he, they went backward, and fell to the ground.
耶穌一說「我就是」，他們就退後倒在地上。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Then asked he them again, Whom seek ye? And they said, Jesus of Nazareth.
他又問他們說：「你們找誰？」他們說：「找拿撒勒人耶穌。」

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Ni-mattæ'i-v'lli ta ti Je-sus, Pattæ'i-kah'-an-ato-mau-kamou ka ti jau katta. Heirou kmi-'ym-kamou jau-an, pad'arang-au-to ta neni k'atta.
Jesus answered, I have told you that I am he: if therefore ye seek me, let these go their way:
耶穌說：「我已經告訴你們，我就是。你們若找我，就讓這些人去吧。」

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. That the saying might be fulfilled, which he spake, Of them which thou gavest me have I lost none.
這要應驗耶穌從前的話，說：「你所賜給我的人，我沒有失落一個。」

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. fields.text: Ka ti Simon Petrus ka mei-tierrau, ta ni-lmouhgout ki anna, ka ni-maphyt ki koungcia ki Dadyllo ka Si-bavau, ka ni-palikkud tyn ta tangira tyn ka ouwal. Ka ti Malchus ta nanang ki koungcia kanna.
Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it, and smote the high priest's servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant's name was Malchus.
西門‧彼得帶着一把刀，就拔出來，將大祭司的僕人砍了一刀，削掉他的右耳；那僕人名叫馬勒古。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. fields.text: Anna ta ni-k'ma ta ti Je-sus ti Petrus-an, Pou-karouloung-au ta tierrau oho. Hæuugh kanna ka æ̈yht-tæn ka na pæp'æ ki Ra-ma jau-an, assi-mau yht-tei ta anna?
Then said Jesus unto Peter, Put up thy sword into the sheath: the cup which my Father hath given me, shall I not drink it?
耶穌就對彼得說：「收刀入鞘吧，我父所給我的那杯，我豈可不喝呢？」

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. fields.text: Annata kabatoung-an k'anna, ki Meisasou-appa ki sat katounnoun-an lam ki koungcia ki Joden ni-ta-sal ta yng'it ti Jesus-an bæuut tyni-æn.
Then the band and the captain and officers of the Jews took Jesus, and bound him,
那隊兵和千夫長，並猶太人的差役就拿住耶穌，把他捆綁了，

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. fields.text: Ka ni-mad tyni-æn si-ou-rou ti Annas-an: alei ka raram-an ta teni ki kei-jen ti Ka-i-fas, ka Dadyllo ka Si-bavau tou tauwil k'anna.
And led him away to Annas first; for he was father in law to Caiaphas, which was the high priest that same year.
先帶到亞那面前，因為亞那是本年作大祭司該亞法的岳父。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Ka ti Ka-i-fas ta ti anna ka ni-matamha ki Joden, ka ma-riang-âl-ato, rou kapatei-eih ki saät ki voual mi-v'lli ki ta'u.
Now Caiaphas was he, which gave counsel to the Jews, that it was expedient that one man should die for the people.
這該亞法就是從前向猶太人發議論說「一個人替百姓死是有益的」那位。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. fields.text: Ka ni-smala-dyllough ta ti Simon Petrus ti Jesus-an, lam ki Pahtatæutæu-han ka pani. Ka Pahtatæutæu-han kanna ta k'a-lang-in ki Dadyllo ka Si-bavau, ka ni-sa-rarbo-en tyn lam ti Je-sus-an tou laf ki Dadyllo ka Sibavau.
And Simon Peter followed Jesus, and so did another disciple: that disciple was known unto the high priest, and went in with Jesus into the palace of the high priest.
西門‧彼得跟着耶穌，還有一個門徒跟着。那門徒是大祭司所認識的，他就同耶穌進了大祭司的院子。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. But Peter stood at the door without. Then went out that other disciple, which was known unto the high priest, and spake unto her that kept the door, and brought in Peter.
彼得卻站在門外。大祭司所認識的那個門徒出來，和看門的使女說了一聲，就領彼得進去。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. fields.text: Annata ni-k'ma ti Pe-trus-an ta ina kanna ka koungcia ka souajam tou ngataf, Assi kau-wa ymhou-appa ta na Pahtatæutæuugh ki voual katta? Ni-k'ma ta teni, Assi ti jau.
Then saith the damsel that kept the door unto Peter, Art not thou also one of this man's disciples? He saith, I am not.
那看門的使女對彼得說：「你不也是這人的門徒嗎？」他說：「我不是。」

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. And the servants and officers stood there, who had made a fire of coals; for it was cold: and they warmed themselves: and Peter stood with them, and warmed himself.
僕人和差役因為天冷，就生了炭火，站在那裏烤火；彼得也同他們站着烤火。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. fields.text: Annata ni-tmaligh ta Da-dyllo ka Si-bavau ti Jesus-an alei ki Pahtatæutæu-'han tyn, ki ni-pahtæutæu-en-nappa tyn.

大祭司就以耶穌的門徒和他的教訓盤問他。

fields.text: Ka ni-mou-rbo mi-la tou ta-lach ka keirang-en ki papæamæmæ-æn, ka ni-k'ma ti Jesus-an, Mang kow ki euma? Râ assi ni-mattæ'i-v'lli ta ti Jesus ki sou tyni-æn.
And went again into the judgment hall, and saith unto Jesus, Whence art thou? But Jesus gave him no answer.
又進衙門，對耶穌說：「你是哪裏來的？」耶穌卻不回答。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Anna ta ni-kma ta ti Pilatus tyni-æn, Assi ymhou-kauwa ka yngau-eih jau-an? Assi kow kauwa mou-mhga ka akou-ligh-koh tou pou-na-vævære-hæn ymhou-an, ka akou-ligh-app'-oh tou 'æumi'-en ymhou-an?
Then saith Pilate unto him, Speakest thou not unto me? knowest thou not that I have power to crucify thee, and have power to release thee?
彼拉多說：「你不對我說話嗎？你豈不知我有權柄釋放你，也有權柄把你釘十字架嗎？」

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Ni-mattæ'i-v'lli ta ti Je-sus, A'ou-si-ah-kow ki ligh jau-an, heirou ni-ynna pæp'æn ta atta makka vavau ymhou-an: alei ki anna teni ka ni-pæ'æ-tounnoun jau-an ymhou-an, akou varau ka si-ourou irang.
Jesus answered, Thou couldest have no power at all against me, except it were given thee from above: therefore he that delivered me unto thee hath the greater sin.
耶穌回答說：「若不是從上頭賜給你的，你就毫無權柄辦我。所以，把我交給你的那人罪更重了。」

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. fields.text: Tou kidi kanna ni-kmi-'ym ta ti Pilatus ki 'æumi-'eih tyn tyni-æn: râ ni-makou-toun ta Joden, k'ma, Heirou mæumia kow ti att'-an, assi-ato kow rieu ki Si-atigh Si-bavau: vejagh ka papei-nado pa-Pei-sasou tyni-en, makou-douma ta teni ki sou ki Si-atigh Si-bavau.
And from thenceforth Pilate sought to release him: but the Jews cried out, saying, If thou let this man go, thou art not Caesar's friend: whosoever maketh himself a king speaketh against Caesar.
從此，彼拉多想要釋放耶穌，無奈猶太人喊着說：「你若釋放這個人，就不是凱撒的忠臣。凡以自己為王的，就是背叛凱撒了。」

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Irou ka ni-millingigh ta ti Pilatus ki sou katta, ni-ad-tyn ta ti Jesus pa-sa-mamala, ka ni-mier-roung tou ierraroung-an pa-pæ-mæmæh tou i-tou-kou-'an ka pa-nanang-en Lithostrotos, râ tou sou ki Hebreen Gabbatha.
When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he brought Jesus forth, and sat down in the judgment seat in a place that is called the Pavement, but in the Hebrew, Gabbatha.
彼拉多聽見這話，就帶耶穌出來，到了一個地方，名叫「鋪華石處」，希伯來話叫厄巴大，就在那裏坐堂。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. fields.text: Ka si-ttata-nan-en-ato ta 'Ou-vavatoug-han ki Halida-eu-en, tou hivat lava ki ka innim ki tæ'lei: ka ni-k'ma ki Joden, K'yt-tei, ta Mei-sasou ka Si-bavau ymoumi-æn.
And it was the preparation of the passover, and about the sixth hour: and he saith unto the Jews, Behold your King!
那日是預備逾越節的日子，約有午正。彼拉多對猶太人說：「看哪，這是你們的王！」

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. fields.text: Râ ni-makou-toun ta neni, Ar-'au, ar-'au, pou-nævæværæ-'ato tyni-æn. Ni-k'ma ta ti Pilatus neini-æn, Pou-na-væværæh-ei-mau kauwa ta Mei-sasou ka Si-bavau ymoumi-æn? Ni-mattæ'i-vlli ta Tama-P'hgik ka Si-bavau, Äou-si-kame ki Meisa-sou, dyk ki Si-atigh Si-bavau.
But they cried out, Away with him, away with him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priests answered, We have no king but Caesar.
他們喊着說：「除掉他！除掉他！釘他在十字架上！」彼拉多說：「我可以把你們的王釘十字架嗎？」祭司長回答說：「除了凱撒，我們沒有王。」

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. fields.text: Annata ni-pæ'æ-tounnoun tyni-æn pæ'æ-koua neini-æn, alei ka pou-nævæværæh-ei-lato ta teni. Ka ni-mara ta neni ti Jesus-an patæu-pænæh.
Then delivered he him therefore unto them to be crucified. And they took Jesus, and led him away.
於是彼拉多將耶穌交給他們去釘十字架。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. fields.text: . Irou ka aval-len tyn ta na væværæh tyn, ni-tpæpænæh mou-koua [tou i-tou-kou-'an] ka pa-nanang-en i-tou-kou'-an ki tok-touk ki voungo, râ tou sou ki He-breen Golgatha:
And he bearing his cross went forth into a place called the place of a skull, which is called in the Hebrew Golgotha:
他們就把耶穌帶了去。耶穌背着自己的十字架出來，到了一個地方，名叫「髑髏地」，希伯來話叫各各他。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. fields.text: Tou hynna ni-pou-navæ-væræh tyni-æn, ka pou-lam appa tyni-æn rarouha ki pani, tou idi-idi ki sasasat, ka ni-pou-toukad-den nein ta ti Jesus.
Where they crucified him, and two other with him, on either side one, and Jesus in the midst.
他們就在那裏釘他在十字架上，還有兩個人和他一同釘着，一邊一個，耶穌在中間。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. fields.text: Ka ni-smoulad-appa ta ti Pilatus ki na æ'æ̈-halap, ka atta-halap-pen tyn tou na væværæh: ka ni-soulat-tyn kma-hynna, JE-SUS KA MAKKA NAZA-RETH MEISASOU KA SI-BAVAU KI JODEN.
And Pilate wrote a title, and put it on the cross. And the writing was JESUS OF NAZARETH THE KING OF THE JEWS.
彼拉多又用牌子寫了一個名號，安在十字架上，寫的是：「猶太人的王，拿撒勒人耶穌。」

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. fields.text: Na ææ̈-halap kanna ta ni-kitting ki mabatoung ki Joden: alei ka tou tamang ki Euma ta i-tou-kou-'an ki ni-pou-na-væ-væræh-in ta ti Jesus: ka ni-soulat-tin ta anna tou sou ki Hebreen, ki Griekken, ki Romeynen.
This title then read many of the Jews: for the place where Jesus was crucified was nigh to the city: and it was written in Hebrew, and Greek, and Latin.
有許多猶太人念這名號；因為耶穌被釘十字架的地方與城相近，並且是用希伯來、羅馬、希臘三樣文字寫的。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. fields.text: Annata ni-k'ma ta Ta-ma-P'hgik ka Si-bavau ki Joden ti Pilatus-an, Ynn'-ei-to smoulat, Ta Mei-sasou ka Si-bavau ki Jo-den: Râ att-'appa, ka ni-pa-sou-sou-en tyn, Mei-sasou-koh ka Si-bavau ki Joden.
Then said the chief priests of the Jews to Pilate, Write not, The King of the Jews; but that he said, I am King of the Jews.
猶太人的祭司長就對彼拉多說：「不要寫『猶太人的王』，要寫『他自己說：我是猶太人的王』。」

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. 彼拉多說：「我所寫的，我已經寫上了。」

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. They said therefore among themselves, Let us not rend it, but cast lots for it, whose it shall be: that the scripture might be fulfilled, which saith, They parted my raiment among them, and for my vesture they did cast lots. These things therefore the soldiers did.
他們就彼此說：「我們不要撕開，只要拈鬮，看誰得着。」這要應驗經上的話說： 他們分了我的外衣， 為我的裏衣拈鬮。 兵丁果然做了這事。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. 站在耶穌十字架旁邊的，有他母親與他母親的姊妹，並革羅罷的妻子馬利亞，和抹大拉的馬利亞。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. 耶穌見母親和他所愛的那門徒站在旁邊，就對他母親說：「母親，看，你的兒子！」

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Then saith he to the disciple, Behold thy mother! And from that hour that disciple took her unto his own home.
又對那門徒說：「看，你的母親！」從此，那門徒就接她到自己家裏去了。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. After this, Jesus knowing that all things were now accomplished, that the scripture might be fulfilled, saith, I thirst.
這事以後，耶穌知道各樣的事已經成了，為要使經上的話應驗，就說：「我渴了。」

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Now there was set a vessel full of vinegar: and they filled a spunge with vinegar, and put it upon hyssop, and put it to his mouth.
有一個器皿盛滿了醋，放在那裏；他們就拿海絨蘸滿了醋，綁在牛膝草上，送到他口。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. fields.text: Irou ka ni-k-dymman ta ti Jesus ki mapyngit, ni-k'ma, Pei-kah-'an-nato mei-amut: ka rou mæ̈-'u-sousou ki voungo ni-myh-taraæuh ki hynnaua.
When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.
耶穌嘗了那醋，就說：「成了！」便低下頭，將靈魂交付上帝了。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

fields.text: Annata ta Joden alei ka assi pa-i-tou-koua-eih tou na væ-væræh ta vouävoual rou wæ'i ki pæ'i-habab-'an, alei ka kidi-ato ki si-ä-tatanang-en (nda tou kei-rang-en ta wæ'i kanna ki pæ-'i-ha-bab'-an) ni-tmou-mymmia ti Pi-latus-an, ki vla-ei ki toural nein, ka 'æumi-eil-lappa ta neni.

The Jews therefore, because it was the preparation, that the bodies should not remain upon the cross on the sabbath day, (for that sabbath day was an high day,) besought Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.
猶太人因這日是預備日，又因那安息日是個大日，就求彼拉多叫人打斷他們的腿，把他們拿去，免得屍首當安息日留在十字架上。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. 於是兵丁來，把頭一個人的腿，並與耶穌同釘第二個人的腿，都打斷了。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. fields.text: Irou-ra mou-koua ti Je-sus-an, rou k'ytt'an nein ka piskaha-ato mapatei, anna ta assi nein ni-vlan ta toural tyn.
But when they came to Jesus, and saw that he was dead already, they brake not his legs:
只是來到耶穌那裏，見他已經死了，就不打斷他的腿。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. But one of the soldiers with a spear pierced his side, and forthwith came there out blood and water.
惟有一個兵拿槍扎他的肋旁，隨即有血和水流出來。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. And he that saw it bare record, and his record is true: and he knoweth that he saith true, that ye might believe.
看見這事的那人就作見證－他的見證也是真的，並且他知道自己所說的是真的－叫你們也可以信。

root_attributes.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa.
